items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: Well my biggest teacher was Leonard Heywood. That was my first teacher and he was my music teacher, my drum teacher, he was the band director for the school, and my mentor.

ctx.x: Who were the teachers that you would credit?
Well my biggest teacher was Leonard Heywood. That was my first teacher and he was my music teacher, my drum teacher, he was the band director for the school, and my mentor.
